I could not determine which merged pull requests added or removed `configUrls` lines since 2026-04-11, or when they merged. The Falkon tools available to me only search the current contents of files. The history tools (`list_commits`, `get_diff`) that the Falkon instructions mention are not exposed in this session, so I have no commit or PR data to report.

What I could establish is where `configUrls` currently appears under `packages/tooling/openmrs` on the default branch of `openmrs-esm-core`. These are the lines a historical change would most likely have touched, but they are not themselves evidence of any PR:

- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/src/commands/build.ts:75-77` builds `configUrls` from the build config or CLI args and pushes config basenames into it.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/src/commands/build.ts:132` passes `configUrls` into the build output.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/src/commands/develop.ts:25` destructures `configUrls` from the develop args.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/src/commands/develop.ts:44` writes `configUrls` into the served development config.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/src/utils/config.ts:49-50` sets `OMRS_CONFIG_URLS` from `configUrls`, joined with semicolons.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/src/commands/debug.ts:26` forwards `configUrls` from the debug args.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/src/cli.ts:164` and `:286` map the `--config-url` flag to `configUrls`.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/README.md:199` documents the `--config-url` option that maps to `configUrls`.
